legend: You are writing code for a hackathon where you need to decode Binary ALGOL Punch Cards. You have already come up with the optimal solution and only need to type it out. The solution consists of c$$$c$$$ characters, and your typing speed is 1$$$1$$$ character per time unit. However, your computer is prone to sudden crashes: after every character you type there is a probability of p$$$p$$$ that your computer crashes and you need to start over again. Recovering after a crash costs r$$$r$$$ time units, and you can then continue typing from the last point where you saved your code.
You can click "Save" at any time (which costs t$$$t$$$ time units) to save your code and to be able to restart from this point after crashes. Clicking "Save" will not cause your computer to crash.
Determine how many (expected) time units you need to complete the code. Note that the code should be saved after typing the last character.
input: One line with three integers c$$$c$$$, t$$$t$$$, and r$$$r$$$ (1≤c≤2000$$$1 \leq c \leq 2000$$$, 0≤t,r≤109$$$0 \leq t, r \leq 10^9$$$), indicating the number of characters, the time cost of clicking "Save", and the time cost of recovering after a crash.

One line with a floating-point number p$$$p$$$ (0.001≤p≤0.999$$$0.001 \leq p \leq 0.999$$$, with at most 10$$$10$$$ digits after the decimal point), the probability that your computer crashes after a character press.
output: Output the expected number of time units you need to complete the code.
Your answer should have an absolute or relative error of at most 10−6$$$10^{-6}$$$.

legend.ai: 你正在为一次黑客马拉松编写代码，需要解码二进制 ALGOL 穿孔卡片。你已经想出了最优解，只需要将其输入计算机。该解包含 c$$$c$$$ 个字符，而你的打字速度为每个时间单位输入 1$$$1$$$ 个字符。然而，你的计算机容易突然崩溃：每输入一个字符后，计算机都有 p$$$p$$$ 的概率崩溃，此时你需要重新开始。崩溃后的恢复需要花费 r$$$r$$$ 个时间单位，之后你可以从上次保存代码的位置继续输入。
你可以随时点击“保存”(这需要花费 t$$$t$$$ 个时间单位)来保存代码，并在崩溃后从该位置重新开始。点击“保存”不会导致计算机崩溃。
请确定完成代码所需的（期望）时间单位数。注意，输入最后一个字符后也应保存代码。

input.ai: 一行包含三个整数 c$$$c$$$、t$$$t$$$ 和 r$$$r$$$(1≤c≤2000$$$1 \leq c \leq 2000$$$，0≤t,r≤109$$$0 \leq t, r \leq 10^9$$$)，分别表示字符数量、点击“Save”的时间代价，以及崩溃后恢复所需的时间代价。
一行包含一个浮点数 p$$$p$$$(0.001≤p≤0.999$$$0.001 \leq p \leq 0.999$$$，小数点后最多有 10$$$10$$$ 位)，表示按下一个字符后计算机发生崩溃的概率。

output.ai: 输出完成代码所需的时间单位数的期望值。
答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10−6$$$10^{-6}$$$。
